lines.name: Harbour Line
lines.beyond: south on Sunset Way beyond y -780; north on Harbour Road beyond y 320 (termini and depot off-sheet)

notes: What changed: S1 Skyport Line stays as drawn (straight trunk at y 0 plus the R40 loop round the skyport over water), so it is not listed. T1 now runs straight through Crown Circus. It crosses the island at x 0, eases over to x 5 in Crown Avenue (two small-angle bends with R50 fillets), then makes an R50 turn at x 5, y 289 onto Crown Road west and leaves the sheet at x -400. The balloon loop is dropped; with no line end inside the sheet, T-L1 no longer applies. The path id 'trunk' is kept so the current stops still attach. Nothing was run: I had no checker here, so all of the geometry below is hand-checked only and needs a checker run.

Tide's two-way Sky Loop round the ring is rejected. To stay on the ring roads (24 m wide) through the 90° corners, an R70 curve needs the alignment about 20.5 m out from the inside kerb corner. With the beams 6 m apart, the inner beam swings over corner plots, which breaks S-C1 (public space only). It would also bring back the loop the plan retires (open question 3). The western areas it would have served are covered by T2 instead.

T2 is not Harbour Road only. The road ends at Comet Row (y -720), so a tram can't reach the south sheet edge within street space (T-C1), and a 24 m street is too narrow for an R25 balloon loop (T-L1). So T2 runs south off-sheet on Sunset Way, along Market Street, then up Harbour Road off-sheet north. Both ends leave the sheet (N-D1). It gives stops in reach of rocket-west, lantern-west, docks-court and docks-east, which the current lines leave beyond the 250 m reach.

The R50 corners fit inside the street by running off-centre. Sunset Way at x -349, Harbour Road at x 309, Crown Avenue at x 5, Crown Road at y 289. Market Street runs at y -406 in the west and y -414 in the east, with a small-angle shift between x -100 and 100. In each case both tracks (±1.8) stay within the kerbs and the inner track's arc stays inside the junction. I checked this against the road widths only. The checker's road polygons may be stricter or looser at junctions.

Interchange spacing for Vantage, within 150 m: T1 and S1 at Crown Circus (T1 now crosses the island, under S1). T2 and S1 at Harbour Road, x 309, about 40 m from the Harbour station (340, 0). T1 and T2 at the Boulevard and Market Street crossing (0, -410), next to the Records stop.

Source conflicts for Aster: the plan concept note still says T1 turns on an R28 balloon loop round the island and that Crown Circus is the one interchange. Its 'why' notes describe an older single-track tram and a separate harbour loop. Open question 2 (end T1 at the circus, or run on up Crown Avenue) is still open in the plan. I followed tide's draft (run through the circus). Sky should confirm before Vantage moves stops, and the concept notes need updating to match.

Next steps: Vantage places and re-projects the stops (T1 stops on the new trunk, T2 stops 300–500 m apart, interchange stops), then runs bun tools/plan/cli.ts. If T-C1 fails at a corner, send it back to me (Datum) with the failing vertex. No rule was loosened.
